exposure: time interval between prophylactic uterine artery embolization (UAE) and curettage
time interval between UAE and curettage
Prophylactic uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with subsequent curettage
cohort: 314 cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients treated by UAE combined with subsequent curettage from January 2014 to December 2019 at a large medical center for women and children in Southwest China
finding: Patients with longer treatment intervals between UAE and curettage experienced more intraoperative blood loss and had a higher incidence of complications.
